source.chapter_title: Effects of the planets in the twelve houses

notes: Clauses about life span, death, named diseases and physical defects are omitted under the sensitive-topics policy; affected rules list them in 'dropped'. Sloka 34: Rahu acts like Saturn and Ketu like Mars. Slokas 34-35: a planet gives full results near the middle of the house and less towards its edges (not applied, since houses are whole-sign).

rules.text: Sun in the 1st house: thin hair, tall build; slow to take up work, quick-tempered, proud, impatient and hard-hearted.

variants.text: With Libra rising (the Sun debilitated): financial hardship and difficulty concerning children.

rules.text: Sun in the 2nd house: short on learning, modesty and wealth.
Sun in the 3rd house: strong, brave, wealthy and generous, but at odds with relatives.
Sun in the 4th house: little domestic happiness, few close relatives or friends, and no settled land or house; works for the state and spends the family inheritance.
Sun in the 5th house: intelligent, but with less happiness, wealth and joy from children; travels through wild country.
Sun in the 6th house: rises to high position; well known, of good character, wealthy and victorious over rivals.
Sun in the 7th house: displeasure of those in power, much wandering, difficulty in marriage and some humiliation.
Sun in the 8th house: loss of wealth and of friends.
Sun in the 9th house: blessed with children and relatives and devoted to God and the learned, though the father is a source of worry.
Sun in the 10th house: children, vehicles, praise, intelligence, wealth, strength and fame; rises to high authority.
Sun in the 11th house: very wealthy and free from sorrow; rises to high authority.
Sun in the 12th house: at odds with the father; short of wealth and with obstacles concerning children.

variants.text: A waxing Moon in the 1st house: a strong constitution, fearless, very powerful and wealthy.
A waning Moon in the 1st house: the reverse — a weaker constitution, less confidence and less wealth.

rules.text: Moon in the 2nd house: rich, learned and soft-spoken, with a strong love of pleasure.
Moon in the 3rd house: has siblings; strong and forceful with strong desires, but very tight-fisted.
Moon in the 4th house: happy and pleasure-loving; generous, with friends, vehicles and a good name.
Moon in the 5th house: good children, sharp intelligence, a gentle bearing; may rise to an advisory or ministerial role.
Moon in the 6th house: lacks learning and suffers humiliation; health, especially digestion, needs care.
Moon in the 7th house: pleasant to look at and very attractive; loved by a beautiful partner.
Moon in the 8th house: health needs care.
Moon in the 9th house: prosperous, virtuous and blessed with children; victorious, with undertakings succeeding from the outset.
Moon in the 10th house: does good works and helps the virtuous.
Moon in the 11th house: high-minded, with wealth, children and people in one's service.
Moon in the 12th house: disliked by others; suffers hardship and insult, and is very indolent.
Mars in the 1st house: adventurous and very harsh; prone to injury.
Mars in the 2nd house: unattractive features, little learning or wealth, and dependent on bad company.
Mars in the 3rd house: good qualities, wealth, courage, invincibility and happiness, though without siblings.
Mars in the 4th house: without friends, land, happiness, house or vehicles, and deprived of a mother's care.
Mars in the 5th house: unhappy and childless, with many reverses; a back-biter and weak-minded.
Mars in the 6th house: very passionate, wealthy and famous; rises to high position and wins contests.
Mars in the 7th house: does improper things, wanders the roads, and has serious trouble in marriage.
Mars in the 8th house: poor and criticised by people.
Mars in the 9th house: close to those in power yet disliked by others; the father is a source of worry.
Mars in the 10th house: rises to authority — harsh but generous, and praised by important people.
Mars in the 11th house: wealth and happiness; brave, free of sorrow and of good character.
Mars in the 12th house: harsh, a slanderer of mean disposition; little happiness in marriage.
Mercury in the 1st house: speaks sweetly and cleverly; sharp-witted and learned in many subjects.
Mercury in the 2nd house: earns by their own talents; a poet, sincere and attractive in speech, who eats well.
Mercury in the 3rd house: brave, with good siblings, but prone to fatigue and dejection.
Mercury in the 4th house: learned and witty; happy, with friends, land, provisions, wealth and enjoyment.
Mercury in the 5th house: learned and happy, with knowledge of mantra and charms.
Mercury in the 6th house: argumentative, harsh in speech and lazy, yet overcomes the power of opponents.
Mercury in the 7th house: learned and well dressed, with every kind of distinction and a wealthy spouse.
Mercury in the 8th house: widely renowned; supports the family and rises to command.
Mercury in the 9th house: learning and wealth; well conducted, religious, knowledgeable about everything and very eloquent.
Mercury in the 10th house: succeeds in whatever is undertaken; learned, strong, intelligent, happy, truthful and given to good works.
Mercury in the 11th house: truthful, very rich and happy, with people in one's service.
Mercury in the 12th house: unhappy and without learning; suffers humiliation, and is harsh and inactive.
Jupiter in the 1st house: good-looking, fortunate and fearless; blessed with children.
Jupiter in the 2nd house: eloquent, a connoisseur of food, with a pleasing face, wealth and learning.
Jupiter in the 3rd house: treated with disrespect; tight-fisted and inclined to wrong actions, though with a well-known sibling.
Jupiter in the 4th house: lives happily with mother, friends, helpers, children, spouse and plenty.
Jupiter in the 5th house: intelligent and an adviser to those in power, but has worries over children.
Jupiter in the 6th house: lacks drive; skilled in charms and rituals.

rules.text: Jupiter in the 7th house: a good spouse and children; very amiable, and more generous than the father.
Jupiter in the 8th house: poor, earning a living in menial service, and inclined to wrong actions.
Jupiter in the 9th house: a well-known adviser or minister, with wealth and children, eager to do good.
Jupiter in the 10th house: follows the right path, is renowned for virtue, very rich and a friend of those in power.
Jupiter in the 11th house: wealthy, fearless and comfortable, with vehicles but few children.
Jupiter in the 12th house: disliked by others and foul-mouthed; idle, inclined to wrong actions, in menial work, and without children.
Venus in the 1st house: a healthy, attractive body and a happy life.
Venus in the 2nd house: a poet, with riches of many kinds.
Venus in the 3rd house: unhappy, poor, tight-fisted and unpopular; little happiness in marriage.
Venus in the 4th house: good vehicles, a good house, jewels, clothes and perfumes.
Venus in the 5th house: great wealth, protective of others, very wise and blessed with children.
Venus in the 6th house: no opponents, but no riches either.

rules.text: Venus in the 7th house: a good spouse and wealth, though with a tendency to affairs.
Venus in the 8th house: rich and in a commanding position.
Venus in the 9th house: spouse, friends and children, and prosperity through official favour.
Venus in the 10th house: widely renowned, with friends; holds a position of authority and is happily employed.
Venus in the 11th house: rich and comfortable, and fond of company outside the marriage.
Venus in the 12th house: enjoys pleasure, wealth and splendour.

variants.text: Saturn in its own or exalted sign in the 1st house: equal in standing to a ruler, or the head of a town.
Saturn in the 1st house, not in its own or exalted sign: hardship and want from childhood, and a slovenly, indolent streak.

rules.text: Saturn in the 2nd house: unattractive features, little wealth and wrong ways early on; later lives abroad with vehicles, wealth and comforts.
Saturn in the 3rd house: very intelligent, generous and happy with the spouse, but inactive and weighed down by sorrow.
Saturn in the 4th house: unhappy, without house or vehicles, deprived of a mother's care, and in poor health in early years.
Saturn in the 5th house: wandering, with clouded judgement; without children, wealth or happiness; untrustworthy.
Saturn in the 6th house: a hearty eater, wealthy, stubborn and self-respecting, but hard-pressed by opponents.
Saturn in the 7th house: a difficult marriage, poverty, wandering and distress.
Saturn in the 8th house: short of means, harsh-minded, and looked down on by friends.
Saturn in the 9th house: lacks fortune, wealth, children, the father's support and religious merit.
Saturn in the 10th house: rises to high office or advises those in it; devoted to agriculture, brave, rich and renowned.
Saturn in the 11th house: lasting wealth.
Saturn in the 12th house: shameless and poor, without children, and pushed out by opponents.
Rahu in the 1st house: wealth and strength.
Rahu in the 2nd house: insincere in speech yet tender-hearted; gets wealth through government; quick-tempered but happy.
Rahu in the 3rd house: proud, strong-willed and wealthy, but at odds with siblings.
Rahu in the 4th house: foolish and a cause of sorrow to others, though with friends and occasional happiness.
Rahu in the 5th house: childless and hard-hearted.
Rahu in the 6th house: wealthy, though troubled by opponents.
Rahu in the 7th house: loses wealth through affairs, suffers separation from the beloved, and is self-willed and foolish.
Rahu in the 8th house: does unclean things and has few children.
Rahu in the 9th house: contrary in speech and inclined to unprincipled acts, yet the head of the clan or a local leader.
Rahu in the 10th house: famous and fearless, busy with others' affairs, few children, and not given to good works.
Rahu in the 11th house: prosperous, with few children.
Rahu in the 12th house: spends heavily and is drawn to wrong actions in secret.
Ketu in the 1st house: ungrateful, unhappy and a carrier of tales; falls from position and keeps bad company.
Ketu in the 2nd house: without learning or riches; coarse in speech and often dependent on others for food.
Ketu in the 3rd house: strength, wealth and fame; lives happily with the spouse and eats well, though a sibling is a source of grief.
Ketu in the 4th house: loses land, vehicles, the mother's care and happiness; leaves the homeland and lives on others' bounty abroad.
Ketu in the 5th house: loss concerning children and an ill-disposed mind.
Ketu in the 6th house: very magnanimous with the best qualities; lasting fame, firmness and high authority; overcomes opponents and realises wishes.
Ketu in the 7th house: suffers disrespect and seeks poor company; serious strain in marriage.
Ketu in the 8th house: separated from close friends, quarrelsome, and disappointed in undertakings.
Ketu in the 9th house: follows wrong ways, is unlucky and poor, and speaks ill of good people; the father is a source of worry.
Ketu in the 10th house: energetic, bold and widely renowned, but obstacles to good works and a pull towards low acts.
Ketu in the 11th house: saves money, has many good qualities, enjoys life and succeeds in getting what is needed.
Ketu in the 12th house: spends on unworthy things and loses wealth; drawn to wrong actions in secret.
